items.title: Motion recording: knob moves recorded per step (SEQ > MOTION)

source.author: Leo Kuroshita (@kurogedelic), Hügelton Instruments
source.files: firmware/src/motion.c (the 64-event store, base / active, motion_capture, motion_step), hooks in seq.c, ui_input.c, project.c

files: hooks: seq.c (motion_step, motion_begin / motion_end), project.c (capture / apply / flash), params.c MOTION page, ui_draw.c, ui_input.c (knobs, page)

cost.cpu: per step of a track with motion on: a scan of <= 64 records (sequencer, not the render)

items.storage: No project format change (FUN8 is 3,840 B = the whole sector payload). The store (200 B: the project's sum, count, on bits, 64 x 3-byte events) lives beside each project buffer in RAM (pool: 4 slots + autosave + the song's backup) and in flash in the unused bytes 32..255 of the project's own sector (between the 32-byte commit header and the payload at 256): a 208-byte record (magic, store, CRC) programmed after the project's commit; read back only when its CRC holds and its sum is the loaded project's. A build without the switch ignores it, and its next save of that slot drops it. FELUCCA_SECTIONS 8 / 16 (the sections in a log, sec_log.c): each section's record carries its motion as an optional chunk after the flags byte (sec_codec.c SEC_MOT: count, on bits, 3 bytes an event; none recorded, no chunk), power-cut safe and CRC-checked with the section, counted in the MEM gauge; the stores in RAM are the autosave's, the song backup's and those of the two buffers a section passes through (pool, bound at power-on); the first start moves each old slot's motion into its section. feat/drum-sends (FUNA: lanes in their own record at 0xE5000/0xE6000, a 4-byte key in the project) keeps the 256-byte payload offset and the 32-byte header, so the 208 B still fit (16 B spare).
items.limits: 64 events for the four tracks together (Felucca's limit); values -128..127 (every recordable parameter fits); with 4 sections, a live section stored while playing and reset before it reached flash loses its motion (8 / 16: the arena keeps it); a PRJ / AUTO backup of a 4-section build does not hold the motion; not editable from the web editor; motion edits are not undoable
items.notice: Motion recording after Felucca 1.0 by Leo Kuroshita (GPL-3.0).

later_asm_notes.for: any normalisation in the FX buses; in integer form a reciprocal table + one Newton step

later_asm_notes.idea: the compressor's gain from its static curve only every 4 samples, ramped linearly between
later_asm_notes.for: our master limiter / DUCK gain: compute every 4 (or per 8) samples, ramp

later_asm_notes.idea: the limiter's divide replaced by a running reciprocal (updated when the envelope moves)
later_asm_notes.for: fx.c master_out: g = LIM_T / lim_env is a 32-bit divide per sample while limiting
